title: Use DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() instead of raw DateTime.now() in scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart and backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart
why: scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart (6 occurrences: lines 419,420,430,431,446,447) and backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart (2: lines 121,157) seed DB rows / SyncStatus values with raw `DateTime.now().toUtc()`, even though the sibling file settings_screen_r5_regression_test.dart's `_dbWithProfile` in the same feature directory already uses the project's `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` for the identical FK-seeding purpose. TQ-6 is Enforced for lib/ specifically because wall-clock reads are a live nondeterminism source under parallel/randomized test ordering; extending that discipline to test/ is explicitly named as the pending next step, and this batch shows the established in-feature alternative being ignored, not just an isolated slip.
recommendation: Replace the 8 call sites with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc(), matching settings_screen_r5_regression_test.dart's convention.
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() call remains in scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart or backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart; both use DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() or a fixed DateTime.utc(...) literal.
